title: Gears of War: E-Day Release Time, Early Access and Preload Explained
description: Gears of War: E-Day early access starts October 1 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC, with the worldwide launch following October 6. Here are the confirmed preload and launch details.
body:
**Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition early access begins October 1 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC. The worldwide launch follows October 6 at the same time.**

Pre-install is already live on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Steam, so players can download the game before their access window opens. Xbox says Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass members can start playing at the October 6 worldwide launch.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: Gears of War: E-Day key art featuring the skull-and-cog emblem glowing red beneath the E-Day logo.

contentBlocks.text: Premium Edition players can begin playing on October 1 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC. Xbox describes the Premium Edition benefit as up to five days of early access ahead of the standard release. If you are using standard Game Pass access rather than the Premium Edition benefit, your launch is October 6.
contentBlocks.heading: Gears of War: E-Day early access time

contentBlocks.text: The worldwide launch is October 6 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Steam. Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass members can join from this worldwide launch window.
contentBlocks.heading: Gears of War: E-Day worldwide release time

contentBlocks.text: Pre-install began September 29 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Steam. That means both Premium Edition players and standard-launch players can have the game installed before their access begins.
contentBlocks.heading: When can you preload Gears of War: E-Day?

contentBlocks.text: Xbox confirms Gears of War: E-Day as a day-one Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass release on October 6. The October 1 early-access window is a Premium Edition benefit, rather than the standard Game Pass launch date. For more detail, see Neural Critic’s [E-Day Game Pass guide](/stories/gears-of-war-e-day-game-pass/).
contentBlocks.heading: Do Game Pass players get E-Day early access?

contentBlocks.text: Gears of War: E-Day launches on Xbox Series X|S and PC, including Steam. Xbox also supports Xbox Play Anywhere for the title. For more on the game itself, Neural Critic’s [E-Day story trailer coverage](/stories/gears-of-war-e-day-story-trailer-gamescom-2026/) explains the prequel setup with Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago.
contentBlocks.heading: What platforms is Gears of War: E-Day launching on?

quickRead: Premium Edition early access starts October 1 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC.
Worldwide launch is October 6 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC.
Pre-install is already available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Steam.
Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass access begins October 6.
conclusion:
If you have the Premium Edition, the first playable window is **October 1 at 8 a.m. PT / 15:00 UTC**. Everyone joining at the worldwide release—including standard Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass access—can start on **October 6 at the same time**.

With pre-install already available, downloading ahead of time is the simplest way to be ready when your access opens.
